prompts.down:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: game-ready transparent pixel-art animation sheet of Yuuki as a nine-year-old child for a top-down classic RPG.
Input image is the APPROVED character identity reference, NOT a layout reference. Preserve exactly her child proportions, round red eyes, long pure white hair with light lavender shadows, black ribbon/cross hair ornament, modest white peter-pan collar and puff sleeves, black bodice with a little white cross, white knee-length bell skirt with black lace bands, white socks, black Mary Jane shoes. Two feathered wings: anatomical LEFT BLACK, anatomical RIGHT WHITE. Child, no weapons, empty hands. No halo at all: it will be a separate layer in the game.
Match the reference's crisp, carefully shaded pixel sprite style, readable volume and fine controlled outlines. No blurred patches, no smudging, no continuous painting, no realistic face, no mature proportions. Keep her recognizable, natural arms/legs, exactly two hands and two feet.
OUTPUT one landscape sheet 1536x1024, exact regular grid 6 columns by 3 rows. Each cell is 256x~341. Center each body with equal generous clear margins, entire hair, wings, hands and shoes visible. Characters approximately 245px tall in each cell. Same scale/camera for all cells. No decorations, text, labels, gridlines, cast ground shadow, scenery or floor. Genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside sprites, not a checkerboard painted into the art. Transparent separation between every frame.
Read left to right.
TOP ROW: six consecutive frames of a natural LOOPING WALK IN PLACE, contact A, down/pass A, lift A, opposite contact B, down/pass B, lift B. Feet alternately step forward and backwards, opposite arm swing; short gentle stride appropriate for a child. Visible different leg poses and clear foot separation. Last flows back into first. Hair and folded wings follow subtly.
MIDDLE ROW: six consecutive frames of a LOOPING RUN IN PLACE. Bent elbows, forward lean, more energetic alternating legs: left-foot contact, compression, airborne crossing, right-foot contact, compression, airborne crossing. Clearly distinct feet and bent knees. Hair follows movement, wings stay folded, not flapping. No jump sequence.
BOTTOM ROW: only THREE sprites in the first three cells: relaxed standing idle at rest, gentle inhalation lifting chest/shoulders 1-2 pixels, exhalation returning. Both feet planted close together in same positions in all three, arms relaxed. Last three cells stay completely empty and transparent. Not walking in idle. Keep all head/face features and clothing invariant, subtle breathing only.
Motion must be coherent rather than six disconnected poses. Do not change clothing, wing colors, hair length or accessories from frame to frame. Keep character root aligned within cells and feet on the same nominal baseline per row; a few pixels vertical bob only in movement. No stretched or distorted body parts.
DIRECTION AND WING OCCLUSION (critical): Every sprite FACES THE CAMERA / walks DOWN the screen, slight top-down RPG view. White wing on VIEWER LEFT and black wing on VIEWER RIGHT, all frames. Face visible frontally. Do not turn sideways.
